claims.text: The FDA topiramate label says coadministration with alcohol has not been evaluated in clinical studies.
claims.quote: Concomitant administration of topiramate and alcohol or other CNS depressant drugs has not been evaluated in clinical studies.

headline.text: The FDA label says topiramate and alcohol coadministration has not been evaluated in clinical studies.

reported.text: The label identifies a lack of clinical coadministration studies.

gaps.text: The packet's human trials examine treatment of alcohol use rather than an acute coadministration interaction.
